title: A delegation MCP call queued behind another can be cut by Codex's tool_timeout_sec and still run in the serial bridge (duplicate spawn risk on retry)
outcome: A delegation tool call that Codex has already given up on is not sent by the bridge afterwards, or the caller is told for certain whether it was, so a retry of a spawn or an evaluation request cannot make a duplicate child.
acceptance: A delegation MCP call queued behind another can be cut by Codex's tool_timeout_sec and still run in the serial bridge (duplicate spawn risk on retry) is done
